patch_description:
This design replaces the independently parameterized hardware-efficient block with a permutation-equivariant collective mixer. All qubits share one RY angle and one RX angle within each block, matching the symmetry of the 28 pairwise feature couplings and the mean-Z readout. The fixed IsingZZ feature map already supplies data-dependent entanglement, so additional fixed entanglers are unnecessary.

The two independently parameterized repeats after each upload compose the shared X/Y rotations into a flexible collective single-qubit transformation. Using noncommuting X and Y axes also converts the uploaded phase information into measurable Z populations, while avoiding redundant RZ-heavy layers. The result uses only 2 parameters per block and 14 total parameters, compared with 146 in the seed, while reducing circuit gate count and depth and imposing a strong inductive bias intended to improve generalization and convergence.
